complement.summary: Two characters with clearly different main colours and different structure.

colour_rule.text: a_main and b_main differ by CIEDE2000 >= 15 (warning only).

contrast_rule.text: At least 5 measurable contrasts on distinct axes, at most 2 of them colour axes.

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: A and B each keep their own role colours; the partner's colours must not appear.

leader_chaotic.summary: A calm leader and an energetic partner.

colour_rule.text: a_main and b_main differ by CIEDE2000 >= 15 (warning only).

contrast_rule.text: As complement, and expression or shape_language is among the contrasts.

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: A and B each keep their own role colours; the partner's colours must not appear.

same_club.summary: A team or club look: a shared main colour is welcome; the difference comes from structure.

colour_rule.text: No main-colour rule: the pair may share a main colour.

contrast_rule.text: At least 5 measurable contrasts, at most 1 colour axis, and at least 4 from hair, face, cut, print or accessory axes.

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: The shared main colour is never a leak; the other role colours are tested as usual.

mirror.summary: Swapped colour roles or a mirrored composition, with different structure.

colour_rule.text: Swapped roles: a_main close to b_second and b_main close to a_second (CIEDE2000 <= 10, warning only).

contrast_rule.text: As complement, plus a different hair kit style, garment type and accessory category.

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: Swapped roles are shared by design and never count as a leak.

seasonal_twins.summary: One theme with two season palettes.

colour_rule.text: a_main and b_main fall into different season groups (data/season_map.json) and differ by CIEDE2000 >= 15 (warning only).

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: A and B each keep their own role colours; the partner's colours must not appear.

object_mascot.summary: Two human blocky characters; the mascot is the signature accessory or the linked accessory pair.

colour_rule.text: a_main and b_main differ by CIEDE2000 >= 15 (warning only).

contrast_rule.text: As complement, plus at least one accessory of kind plush_pet, keychain_charm or prop with linked_to_partner true, or an accessory_pair anchor.

cut_rule.text: A and B differ in top or bottom garment type (the recipe family) and in at least 2 of: sleeve, hem, leg, neckline, front, block_layout. No structure has an exception.

leak_policy.text: A and B each keep their own role colours; the partner's colours must not appear.
